description.zh:
检查范围，取值：
- **FULL**：扫描所有检查项
- **POLICY**：扫描自定义配置的检查项
description.en:
The scan range. Valid values:
- **FULL**: scans all check items
- **POLICY**: scans custom-configured check items

description.zh:
任务来源。取值：

- **YAO_CHI**：瑶池控制台。
description.en:
The task source. Valid values:

- **YAO_CHI**: Alibaba Cloud ApsaraDB console.

title.en: Submit a cloud service configuration check

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas submit-check --scan-range POLICY --task-source YAO_CHI --resource-directory-account-id 1 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas SubmitCheck --region cn-hangzhou --ScanRange POLICY --ResourceDirectoryAccountId 1 --TaskSource YAO_CHI
